title: Leveraging Chatbot to Improve PrEP in the Southern United States
official: Leveraging Chatbot Technology to Improve PrEP Awareness and Uptake Among Black MSM in the Southern United States
summary: The purpose of this study is to develop a chatbot intervention to promote PrEP awareness and uptake among Black men who have sex with men (MSM) in the Southern United States.

interventions.name: A chatbot designed to promote PrEP awareness and uptake for Black MSM

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Being cisgender Black male
* Being aged ≥ 18 years
* Having Internet access
* Speaking English
* Self-reporting condomless sex with another man in the past 6 months
* Living in the U.S. South
* HIV negative or untested.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not residing in a U.S. Census Bureau-defined Southern state: AL, AR, DE, FL, GA, KY, LA, MD, MS, NC, OK, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV.
* Having received antiretroviral therapy (ART) treatment.
